title: 세이프 하우스
ctx: Film 「Safe House」(2012, Universal, director Daniel Espinosa). Ryan Reynolds as Matt Weston, a junior CIA officer bored as housekeeper of a Cape Town safe house; Denzel Washington as Tobin Frost, a legendary rogue CIA agent who walks into the US consulate; Vera Farmiga as Catherine Linklater; Brendan Gleeson as David Barlow (secretly corrupt, he sells info); Sam Shepard as Harlan Whitford; Nora Arnezeder as Ana Moreau, Matt's French girlfriend; Robert Patrick as Daniel Kiefer; Fares Fares as Vargas, the mercenary leader; Liam Cunningham as Alec Wade, ex-MI6 who sold Frost a file. Frost carries a file exposing corrupt intelligence officers; the safe house is attacked and Weston must keep Frost alive across Cape Town to Langa township and a farm safe house.
